summary: Create risk-based test strategies and verify release acceptance.
intents: write a test plan for the new checkout
is this release ready to ship
which areas need regression testing after this change
summarize the test results from CI
define acceptance criteria for the feature
not_for: standalone definitions of unit, integration, or testing concepts without a quality plan or test decision
implementation of one isolated function using TDD without broader QA strategy
prerequisites: product requirements, user journeys, or an observable behavior contract
repository, test environment, or a clear description of the system under test
known risk areas and release constraints where available

verify.description: No failing or erroring tests in the release candidate

verify: Test coverage follows a stated risk ranking
Known issues are listed with severity and an owner
